spec.title: HashiStack / SSHadowForge
spec.description: The forge's event pipeline: the gateway admitting commands, the projector and notifier consuming the bus, the dispatcher merging and requesting builds, the workflow building -- with the seal refusals (ADR-0145) and the dispatcher's per-step timings that say where its time goes.

spec.title: Doors up
spec.description: Metrics doors answering: gateway, projector, notifier, dispatcher and the workflow's (Nomad-registered). Fewer than 5 is a service down or a door refusing Prometheus.

spec.title: Firing forge alerts
spec.description: SshadowforgeProjectorStalled / EventsRefused / GatewayErrors. EventsRefused fires on purpose after every `make verify` (check 45's forgeries).

spec.title: Projector backlog
spec.description: Events on the bus the projector has not applied yet.

spec.title: Projector idle
spec.description: Seconds since the projector last completed work. Only a stall WITH a backlog is a problem.

spec.title: Gateway 5xx ratio
spec.description: A 503 here is often the auth seal failing closed: the gateway could not reach Vault to sign.

spec.title: Refused events (1h)
spec.description: Events the consumers refused: no valid gateway seal, a bad signature or a contract violation. Nothing the gateway admits is refused.

spec.title: Requests by route
spec.description: Route PATTERNS (bounded cardinality), never raw paths.

spec.title: Latency p95 by route
spec.description: POST /v1/commands includes introspection, the Keto check, the Vault seal and the bus publish.

spec.title: Authz latency p95
spec.description: Hydra introspection and Keto checks, per gateway request (measured p50 ~9 ms each).

spec.title: Admissions and refusals
spec.description: accepted vs each refusal reason (schema, signature, forbidden, unauthenticated, wrong key).

spec.title: Projection rate by outcome
spec.description: applied / skipped / transient (retried, R9) / rejected (poison, Term'd).

spec.title: Notifier outcomes
spec.description: consumed / notified / ignored / rejected (chat posts to chit-server).

spec.title: Dispatcher step p95
spec.description: Where one event's time goes. The dispatcher handles events one at a time (MaxAckPending 1), so a slow step delays every repository. Measured: head_resolve (git ls-remote) is the tail.

spec.title: Dispatcher step time share
spec.description: Seconds per second spent in each step: the budget, not the latency.

spec.title: Memory by job
spec.description: Includes the build runners (sshadowforge-runner-*): a devcontainer build reserves ~3.8 GB.

spec.title: Health -- every tile should be green
